# `bin/merge`

A tool: run it from the root of an instance (or of the kit, for the kit's own tools).
Source: [`bin/merge`](../../../bin/merge)

## What it says about itself

```text
bin/merge RUN

RULES.md step 4. Joins RUN/check.json with every well-formed referee.json (any run whose
output/referee.json names RUN) into the verdict table: claim | tag | check | referee | earned.
Writes RUN/verdict.md, prints it with the paths the operator reads directly. Referee notes are not
printed here: the orchestrator does not summarize referee prose. Malformed referee output is
listed as INVALID and ignored for the earned tag (a finding that is not typed does not exist).
```
